summary: Frontend testing of Elder landing page at /produits/elder. All 29 tests passed (100%). Verified all 9 sections: Hero, Stats (4 cards), How It Works (3 steps), Protection (4 zones), Technology (6 specs), Lifestyle, Testimonials (3 cards), Pricing (2 options with 'Recommended' badge), FAQ (6 items with toggle), Final CTA. Header scroll transition works correctly. Homepage regression passed (9/9 sections). Navigation from homepage to Elder page works.

integration_issues.issue: CORS error when calling ipapi.co/json/ for language/currency auto-detection. Known issue from previous iteration - site falls back to browser language detection.
